fieldNotes.price: The price.min and price.max values are the displayed selling price for the stated pack, not a nationwide fixed price. price.mrp is the displayed MRP. Prices and availability can vary by PIN code and date.
fieldNotes.strength: If a retailer category listing does not expose the ingredient or numeric strength, the field explicitly says it was not stated rather than guessing.
fieldNotes.requiresPrescription: Boolean reflects whether an Rx marker was visible in the captured retailer listing. Absence of an Rx badge is not a legal determination that a medicine is OTC; verify the product page and applicable Indian rules.
fieldNotes.source: Each product includes retailer and category-page source. Apollo OTC category pages were used for the newly added records; Netmeds was used for some original records.
